newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel not changing Jan-Mar prices.
newsitem.headline: China Steel not changing Jan-Mar prices.

text.p: China Steel Corp, Taiwan's largest steelmaker, said on Friday it had decided to keep most of its steel product prices unchanged in the first quarter of 1997 to reflect local and international market trends.

The firm would keep the price of steel plates, hot-rolled sheets and cold-rolled sheets unchanged at T$11,800, T$10,350 and T$13,350 per tonne, respectively, the same as its current fourth quarter prices, it said in a statement.
China Steel would lower the price of electromagnetic sheets to T$16,300 per tonne from T$16,800, the statement added.
